composition.what: P5 composition: two qualified high_degree_fan patches joined into one assembly; reference = ONE solve_equilibrium on the joined mesh (connectivity union, seam deduplicated); no new physics

A.port_in: vertical dead load at the seam apex (rim pinned)

B.port_out: reactions at the far rim pins (rim pinned)

seam.weld: apex-to-apex hourglass; the seam is a free INTERIOR vertex whose opposing film pulls balance (real port transfer). Rim-ring welds are structurally impossible under this law: a free ring has no equilibrium (film contraction, the packet's own exclusion) and a pinned ring transfers nothing -- both witnessed in composed_patch_checks.py check (g)

ports.input: vertical dead load (0.8 N <= packet max_force_N) at the seam apex on piece A's side
ports.output: reactions at piece B's far rim pins

composition.scale_axis: packet physical-size axis (0.5-2.0 m at unit gamma); resolution axis (n_rim) untouched

topology_witnesses.pinned_seam_ring: zero B-port transfer (bit-identical reactions with/without load)

declared_verdict.recomputed_from: packet acceptance_thresholds (the preregistered 1e-6 balance/free-residual law); composed schema adds no thresholds
